# Accessibility

We want everyone to be able to use pyck and to contribute to it. An
accessibility barrier counts as a defect.

## Reporting a barrier

- Open an issue with the **Defect** form in the repository it concerns. Say
  what you tried to do, what blocked you, and which assistive technology,
  browser and operating system you use.
- If you cannot use GitHub issues, email <hello@pyck.ai> instead.
